scope: Two next-version measurement policies only; old definitions, frozen oracle, native failed stage, Registry, thresholds, scoring, PIT and technical admission stay unchanged.

findings.contract: Latest gross margin versus prior comparable period; public callable says previous comparable-duration margin.
findings.actual_read_only_algorithm: Build exact start/end/unit revenue+GrossProfit pairs, sort end descending; current=first; prior=first remaining pair with equal currency and duration difference <=45 days. No year/quarter positioning and no explicit prior.end < current.end predicate.
findings.consequence: Latest earlier Q3 can replace same-quarter prior-year Q1. Same-end alternative starts can in principle satisfy comparator; that last structural risk is inferred from code, not an executed counterexample.
findings.existing_fixture_limit: Only FY2023/FY2024 annual margins 0.5/0.6; all plausible annual/YoY/previous-duration definitions coincide at +0.1 positive. Fixture has no issuer declaration and must remain historical, not be silently repaired.

findings.contract: Year-over-year revenue growth versus prior comparable period; public callable says earlier comparable growth rate.
findings.actual_read_only_algorithm: Each inner pair has end separation330..400 days, same currency and duration difference<=45 days. Outer prior is first earlier growth pair in same currency; it does not require current/prior growth durations to agree or require adjacency or prior-year alignment.
findings.consequence: Annual and quarterly growth rates may be subtracted. A missing latest prior-year partner may cause the latest supported older pair to become current. These are under-specified/current implementation choices, not proof of a single already-explicit QoQ/YoY contract being violated.
findings.existing_fixture_limit: Only FY2022/FY2023/FY2024 revenues80/100/150; both annual-adjacent and same-year-position policies yield0.25 positive. No competing cadence or incomplete-current case.

recommendation.name: Explicit same-fiscal-window year-over-year changes
recommendation.decision_summary: Use prior fiscal-year matching reporting windows for gross-margin change, and year-over-year change of year-over-year revenue growth for acceleration. This is a concrete research-definition choice, not retrospective reinterpretation of old versions.
recommendation.why: A year-separated same fiscal window gives a stable comparison for standalone quarters, cumulative YTD windows and fiscal annual windows, avoids mixing seasonal positions/aggregation lengths, and admits a single three-window chain for acceleration. It intentionally measures change over one fiscal year, not immediate-quarter acceleration. Selection is driven by the definition, not by whether GPRE currently passes.

gross_margin_next_version.current_anchor: Newest eligible canonical total revenue reporting window, not the newest older window that happens to have both operands. Current GrossProfit must match that exact start/end/unit; missing current profit is unavailable.
gross_margin_next_version.prior_anchor: Same issuer, same canonical currency/accounting basis and same reported fiscal window one fiscal year earlier. Annual compares annual, standalone quarter compares same fiscal quarter, YTD compares same fiscal-year-to-date endpoint. Do not substitute a more recent other quarter or relabel YTD as a quarter.
gross_margin_next_version.state_thresholds: Keep version3 positive_min0.08, negative_max-0.02 and existing magnitude/freshness policy; unit fraction_difference.

revenue_acceleration_next_version.current_anchor: Newest eligible canonical total revenue window; require the two preceding matching fiscal windows. Never demote the current anchor to an older complete growth pair when its own comparison is missing.
revenue_acceleration_next_version.prior_anchor: The shared middle window is exactly the same canonical measurement in both ratios. Require three windows in the same fiscal position, duration basis and currency; no current-quarter/previous-annual subtraction, no missing-quarter gap filling.
revenue_acceleration_next_version.state_thresholds: Keep version2 positive_min0.05, negative_max-0.05 and existing magnitude/freshness policy; unit fraction_difference.

matching_and_conflict_policy: Use source-declared fiscal windows and complete reported starts/ends to prove correspondence. Exact one-year shifted starts/ends prove ordinary calendar cases; explicit52/53-week fiscal calendars may prove the equivalent fiscal position. Existing330..400-day/45-day checks can be rejection screens but are not sufficient proof of the same fiscal position.
If fiscal-window correspondence is ambiguous or a transition/stub period cannot be matched, return unavailable with the specific period gap; do not invent a calendar or choose nearest duration alone.

Keep existing issuer/PIT/source/canonical total-tag/currency/freshness policies. Retain exact source literals and revisions. An accepted canonical revision follows existing source resolution; genuinely unresolved same-window contradictions remain unavailable/conflict and cannot be broken merely by document ID.

Do not difference cumulative values into standalone quarters, convert currencies, annualize a quarter, raise document limits or add a canonical business field as part of this decision. Any derived-period capability is separate future scope.

alternative_for_user_review.name: Adjacent reporting-window acceleration
alternative_for_user_review.meaning: Current standalone quarter YoY growth minus immediately previous standalone quarter YoY growth; fiscal annual growth minus immediately previous fiscal annual growth.
alternative_for_user_review.tradeoff: Responds to the most recent change but needs four quarter revenue windows, explicit adjacency and a standalone prior quarter. GPRE Q12025 cannot silently use Q32024 when Q42024 standalone revenue is absent. YTD windows require a separately defined policy; never switch formulas based on available data.
alternative_for_user_review.why_not_default_recommendation: The current generic financial source contract supports both quarterly and cumulative windows and does not uniquely encode adjacency; adopting this alternative is a different valid research question with a larger explicit calendar/window dependency. It should be deliberately named/scoped and separately admitted.

def _revenue_acceleration_signal(
    spec: SignalSpec,
    documents: tuple[RawInfoDocument, ...],
    as_of: datetime,
) -> SignalResult:
    """Measure revenue acceleration as latest year-over-year revenue growth minus an earlier
    comparable growth rate. Requires two supported revenue year-over-year pairs from the
    per-issuer canonical total series (dominance-resolved; never mixed-basis), with
    matching units and nonzero denominators; incomplete/stale current facts yield
    unavailable. Numeric states use positive_min (default 0) and negative_max (default
    positive_min): value >= positive_min is positive, otherwise value <= negative_max is
    negative, otherwise neutral. Thresholds do not change the measurement. Values beyond
    plausible_abs_max (default 5) are downgraded to partial coverage at 0.5 confidence
    with an implausible_value marker. max_period_age_days (default 550) bounds current
    SEC period age; older comparative periods remain allowed.
    """

    basis = _revenue_acceleration_input_facts(spec, documents, as_of)
    if basis.unavailable_reason is not None:
        return _unavailable_result(spec, basis.unavailable_reason)
    current_pair, prior_pair = basis.facts[:2], basis.facts[2:]
    current_growth = current_pair[0].value / current_pair[1].value - 1.0
    prior_growth = prior_pair[0].value / prior_pair[1].value - 1.0
    facts = (*current_pair, *prior_pair)
    return _numeric_result(
        spec,
        current_growth - prior_growth,
        current_pair[0].document,
        as_of,
        label="revenue_acceleration",
        measurement_unit='fraction_difference',
        measurement_formula='latest year-over-year growth - earlier year-over-year growth',
        measurement_period=current_pair[0],
        evidence=_fact_evidence(facts, as_of),
        plausible_abs_max=5.0,
    )

def _gross_margin_change_signal(
    spec: SignalSpec,
    documents: tuple[RawInfoDocument, ...],
    as_of: datetime,
) -> SignalResult:
    """Measure gross-margin change: latest GrossProfit / revenue minus the previous
    comparable-duration margin. GrossProfit and revenue must match start, end and units
    within each period, and revenue comes from the per-issuer canonical total series
    (dominance-resolved; partial or zero same-period tag values never displace the
    total). Missing matched periods, zero revenue or stale current facts yield
    unavailable. Numeric states use positive_min (default 0) and negative_max (default
    positive_min): value >= positive_min is positive, otherwise value <= negative_max is
    negative, otherwise neutral. Thresholds do not change the measurement. Values beyond
    plausible_abs_max (default 2) are downgraded to partial coverage at 0.5 confidence
    with an implausible_value marker. max_period_age_days (default 550) bounds current
    SEC period age; older comparative periods remain allowed.
    """

    basis = _gross_margin_input_facts(spec, documents, as_of)
    if basis.unavailable_reason is not None:
        return _unavailable_result(spec, basis.unavailable_reason)
    r, g, prior_r, prior_g = basis.facts
    current = (r.end, g.value / r.value, r, g)
    previous = (prior_r.end, prior_g.value / prior_r.value, prior_r, prior_g)
    return _numeric_result(
        spec,
        current[1] - previous[1],
        current[2].document,
        as_of,
        label="gross_margin_change",
        measurement_unit='fraction_difference',
        measurement_formula='current gross profit / revenue - previous gross profit / revenue',
        measurement_period=current[2],
        evidence=_fact_evidence(
            (current[2], current[3], previous[2], previous[3]), as_of
        ),
        plausible_abs_max=2.0,
    )

_canonical_series.docstring:
Resolve one canonical per-currency series for an issuer's concept total.

A tag whose same-period value is at least _PARTIAL_VALUE_RATIO times
smaller than a co-occurring value (or zero beside a nonzero value) is a
disaggregation partial and is excluded entirely, including periods no other
tag covers; detection is direction-free and runs before ranking so a
coverage tie can never promote a partial tag. Among remaining total tags
the canonical basis is the coverage-ranked one: latest period end, then
distinct period count, then the declared tag order. A period key covered by
the canonical tag keeps the canonical fact; remaining trusted tags fill only
uncovered keys, so a tag switch or a percent-level restatement crossover
stitches into one series while a partial slice never enters it. When no
fact is eligible, or every present tag is partial, the series is empty and
callers fail closed. With dominance disabled the legacy priority order
stands per key, except a zero-valued preferred tag cannot displace a
nonzero same-period value. Returns one currency's series (USD preferred,
else latest period end, else unit name), latest end first.

_comparable_duration.source:
def _comparable_duration(left: _SecFact, right: _SecFact) -> bool:
    if (left.start is None or right.start is None
            or left.unit.casefold() != right.unit.casefold()):
        return False
    left_days = (
        datetime.fromisoformat(left.end) - datetime.fromisoformat(left.start)
    ).days
    right_days = (
        datetime.fromisoformat(right.end) - datetime.fromisoformat(right.start)
    ).days
    return abs(left_days - right_days) <= 45

_yoy_pairs.source:
def _yoy_pairs(series: list[_SecFact]) -> list[tuple[_SecFact, _SecFact]]:
    pairs: list[tuple[_SecFact, _SecFact]] = []
    for current in series:
        current_end = datetime.fromisoformat(current.end).date()
        candidates = [
            previous
            for previous in series
            if previous.end < current.end
            and 330 <= (current_end - datetime.fromisoformat(previous.end).date()).days <= 400
            and _comparable_duration(current, previous)
        ]
        if candidates:
            pairs.append((current, max(candidates, key=lambda fact: fact.end)))
    return pairs
